instruction: A candid documentary medium-wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor, white walls, and white floor markers. On the left, the man in the black cap and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, extending his right hand to touch the face of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2), who stands on the right facing left with a neutral expression. The room is illuminated by bright overhead fluorescent lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.

R2 is the person whose face is being touched by R1
R1 is the active toucher while R2 receives the face contact
